question: Which of the following organisations was NOT associated with Vinayak Damodar Savarkar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Servants of India Society**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Servants of India Society** was founded by Gopal Krishna Gokhale in 1905 and was aimed at promoting social and human welfare.
 
• Vinayak Damodar Savarkar, also known as Veer Savarkar, was not associated with the Servants of India Society.
 
• Savarkar was primarily associated with revolutionary movements and organizations that were directly involved in the Indian independence struggle.
 
• He was notably involved with organizations like the Hindu Mahasabha, Abhinav Bharat Society, and Free India Society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindu Mahasabha:**

 
 
• A right-wing Hindu nationalist organization in India founded in 1915.
 
• Savarkar served as the president of the Hindu Mahasabha and played a significant role in its activities.
 
 
 
• **Abhinav Bharat Society:**
 
 
• A secret society founded by Savarkar in 1904 aimed at revolutionary activities against British rule in India.
 
• It was initially called Mitra Mela and later renamed Abhinav Bharat.
 
 
 
• **Free India Society:**
 
 
• An organization formed by Indian students in England with the objective of seeking India's independence.
 
• Savarkar was a prominent member and leader of this society.
 
 
 
• **Servants of India Society:**
 
 
• Founded by Gopal Krishna Gokhale with the aim of training Indians to work for the country’s social upliftment.
 
• Focused on promoting education, health, and welfare among the Indian populace.
